list.title: Important Information
list.content: Bodywise’s Hair Growth Pack is developed by trichologists with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 3 months.

list.title: Who should use this Advanced Hair Growth Pack?
list.content: These Biotin Gummies & natural plant based hair serum can be used by anyone who is experiencing Stage 2 Hair Loss (more than 100 strands of hair fall per day &  hair thinning on scalp). Use this pack for 6 months at least to see results.

list.title: How does the Advanced Hair Growth Pack work?
list.content: The Advanced Hair Growth Pack contains Hair Gummies and Hair Growth Serum. Our Hair Gummies contain essential multivitamins like Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamin A, C, and E that are crucial building blocks of hair and help curb hair fall. Our all natural Hair Growth Serum contains plant-based actives that stimulate hair follicles leading to hair growth.

list.title: What is Biotin?
list.content: Our hair is made of a protein called Keratin. Having sufficient keratin is important to keep the hair healthy and strong. Biotin (B7) helps in keratin synthesis. It's a vital supplement for hair loss treatment.

list.title: How does Zinc help in hair fall?
list.content: Zinc plays an important role in hair tissue growth and repair. Having Zinc supplements help treat hair loss caused by insufficient zinc.

list.title: How do Redensyl & Anagain help in Hair Growth?
list.content: Redensyl and Anagain are derived from plants, promote healthy hair growth by prolonging the anagen phase. They shorten the telogen phase, resulting in a significant decrease in hair loss.  These natural actives for hair growth are often considered the best alternative to hair transplants due to their all-natural and non-hormonal hair regrowth qualities.

list.title: How long should I use this pack?
list.content: Use the pack everyday for:  3 months to stop hair fall 4 months to get baby hair growth 6 months for increase in hair volume & density. Since these are made from natural & plant based ingredients, they have no side effects

list.title: Will this pack help in hair loss?
list.content: Our Advanced Hair Growth Pack containing Biotin Hair Gummies & plant based Hair Growth Serum is  an effective and vital solution for hair loss treatment. By just taking one gummy everyday, and applying our serum overnight for 3 months, you can see visible results in hair fall.In 6 months, you will see hair regrowth.

list.title: Are your Hair gummies safe to eat?
list.content: Yes, Hair gummies are 100% safe to eat! They have no preservatives and no artificial colour. They are also Vegan, Gluten Free and Gelatin Free.

list.title: Is it safe for pregnant women?
list.content: Pregnant women should not use Hair Gummies without consulting an expert first.
